**What I found**
No, the gate does not pass, and the PR should not be opened. I couldn't run `check_orchestration.py gate`, so this is a hand-traced result (the record calls it FAIL, `Not run`). The only evidence on either side is E2, `node scripts/compare-totals.js`, which exited 1: 3 of 40 recorded orders were priced differently. Majority is not an allowed way to settle a dispute (`VOTE_NOT_EVIDENCE`). Neither side has passing evidence, so the human decides.
